chronicle.text: Zidos tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Saideiyeis tied a stone flake and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Zidos struck flint with flint and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Suthoulim tied a carrier and a bundle they had tied together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
4 people now take the mark <v-|> to go with wood being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Zidos tied a club and a blade together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
6 people now take the mark <^|\> to go with wood being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Gaiyaireis tied a club and wood together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
5 people now take the mark <\-|> to go with flint being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
3 people now take the mark <|o.> to go with wood being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
3 people now take the mark <./|> to go with stone being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
The mark <v-|> has drifted: it went with wood being struck, and now, for 3 people, with seed sown in autumn.
The mark <./|> has drifted: it went with stone being struck, and now, for 3 people, with deer.
3 people now take the mark <--^> to go with food set down, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
3 people now take the mark <^|/> to go with seed sown in summer, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
3 people now take the mark <vo/> to go with rabbits, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.

Years 0-24: population 20 to 23, 22 births. Deaths mostly from starvation (9), thirst (5), illness (4). Average happiness 0.73. Recorded: 6 inventions, 18 firsts, 13 band changes, 6 new exchange partnerships, 2 new settlements.
6 people now take the mark </o-> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
The mark <--^> has drifted: it went with food set down, and now, for 5 people, with a grave.
3 people now take the mark <\\-> to go with growing food, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
3 people now tell that wolves mauled Saideiyeis. It was a bear. The story changed as it was passed on.
4 people now take the mark <.^.> to go with seed sown in spring, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
4 people now take the mark <oov> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
4 people now take the mark <^|^> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
The mark <^|/> has drifted: it went with seed sown in summer, and now, for 6 people, with rabbits.
4 people now take the mark <o.|> to go with a grave, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
The mark <vo/> has drifted: it went with rabbits, and now, for 5 people, with shelter.

Years 25-49: population 23 to 3, 0 births. Deaths mostly from starvation (11), old age (6), thirst (3). Average happiness 0.60. Recorded: 3 firsts, 9 band changes, 1 new exchange partnerships, 3 new settlements.
